negative_reviews.author: Leoeast
negative_reviews.text: Ordered the katsu curry and gyoza with some tempura squid. Curry came with Asian broccoli which was entirely undercooked and plain. The chicken tasted like it was recently reheated from frozen and the curry was decent. Gyozas were soft and almost raw tasting. The squid was far from enjoyable with the squid tasting plain and the texture was miserable. The atmosphere was great but seems as they put all their money into the decorations. We asked for water and didn't receive it until we asked again after waiting for a long time. Food was insanely overpriced
